# The Tesla Pod

> The Tesla Pod is a video podcast recorded inside a self-driving Tesla (Full Self-Driving, supervised) in San Francisco. Host Irosha de Silva, cofounder and CEO of Marketrix AI, interviews startup founders while the car drives. 12 episodes so far, published on YouTube.

- Host: Irosha de Silva (https://www.irosha.com)
- Format: unscripted founder conversations, recorded in the car on Tesla FSD through San Francisco
- Watch: https://www.youtube.com/@TeslaPod
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/teslapod
- X: https://x.com/theteslapod
- Be a guest: https://www.theteslapod.com/#apply
- Contact and sponsorships: irosha@marketrix.ai
- Not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.

## Insights

- [Why Your Supplier Should Own a Piece of Your Company](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/stock-warrants-suppliers-partners-wrnt): Employees get stock options. The partners who help you grow usually get only cash.
- [Tech Has Ten Thousand Podcasts and Nothing Worth Watching](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/making-tech-media-entertaining-silicon-mania): Food has shows. Sports has shows. Tech has founders talking to founders in cars.
- [Sequoia Said Yes. A Million Users Later, It's Still Free](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/free-mentorship-at-scale-adplist-felix-lee): 39,000 mentors, 600 million minutes, 140 countries — and five years of refusing to charge.
- [The $25M Bet on What Happens to Your Old Clothes](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/ai-secondhand-clothing-supply-chain-fleek): A donated t-shirt crosses continents by hand. Fleek is teaching AI to grade it.
- [Agent Swarms, Sandboxes, and the Coming Security War for AI agents](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/ai-agent-swarms-security-jason-jin): Hundreds of agents from one API call — and attacker agents already probing them.
- [Automating the $1 Trillion Consulting Industry in 24 Hours](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/automating-consulting-with-ai-ontora): McKinsey takes months and millions. Their AI interviews every employee and delivers in a day.
- [Dropping a PhD for YC — and Building a Copilot That Helps Before You Ask](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/proactive-ai-copilots-phd-to-yc-logical): Reactive chatbots wait for prompts. The next copilots watch, learn, and act first.
- [Your Browser Is About to Drive Itself](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/agentic-browsing-self-driving-browser-retriever-ai): The perfect metaphor: an AI browsing the web for you, discussed inside a car driving itself.
- [AI Just Ate Customer Success — What Replaces It](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/ai-customer-success-peazy-labs): The CSM role gets unbundled: an AI concierge inside the product, guiding every user.
- [The $5 Trillion Problem Nobody in Tech Is Working On](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/5-trillion-small-business-succession-silver-surf): 10,000 Boomers retire every day — and 80% of their businesses never sell.
- [They Raised $500K from YC at 18](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/raising-yc-at-18-manicule): Skip the résumé decade: two 18-year-olds on conviction, YC, and docs written for AI agents.
- [Self-Driving Cars and Self-Driving Software](https://www.theteslapod.com/insights/self-driving-software-marketrix-yasith): The founding ride: why software should earn trust the way FSD does — in simulation first.
